title: Lift pointwise equalities through compatible value ranges
obstacle: A valid equality is expressed in a different range from the requested monotone construction.
procedure: Identify the actual input/output value ranges before tactic search.
Prove pointwise equality in the destination range by explicit canonical conversion.
Apply the relevant congruence operation; retain extended values if the target permits infinity.
verification: Check the same sup/measure/index set and no added boundedness premise.
positive_example: Equal real norms induce equal ENNReal norm envelopes.
negative_example: A finite real supremum may require boundedness; equality of finite terms does not prove it.
version_boundary: Pattern observed in these pinned sources; exact APIs must be checked at application.

evidence.excerpt:
theorem parityConjugatedGaussianMaxEnvelope_eq (d : Nat)
    (f : latticeFunction d) :
    parityConjugatedGaussianMaxEnvelope d f =
      gaussianMaxEnvelope d (parityModulation d f) := by
  funext x
  unfold parityConjugatedGaussianMaxEnvelope gaussianMaxEnvelope
  apply iSup_congr
  intro rho
  rw [enorm_eq_nnnorm, enorm_eq_nnnorm]
  norm_cast
  apply NNReal.eq
  simpa only [coe_nnnorm] using
    norm_parityConjugatedGaussianAverage d rho.1 f x
